qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Operates large-scale copper mine assets (Kansanshi, Sentinel, Cobre Panama), but functions as a pure commodity price-taker with selling prices determined entirely by global LME spot markets. Zero pricing power above cost inflation. Returns on capital fluctuate wildly with metal prices and fail the through-the-cycle 12% GAAP ROIC hurdle. High jurisdictional and sovereign expropriation risk demonstrated by the complete shutdown of Cobre Panama by the Panamanian Supreme Court.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Upstream copper mining operation is a pure commodity price-taker lacking pricing power above inflation. Multi-cycle ROIC is sub-hurdle (<10%) and volatile. Severe jurisdictional asset-impairment and sovereign contract risk demonstrated by the Cobre Panama shutdown, causing heavy debt distress and dilution.
qualitative.evidence: First Quantum is heavily reliant on volatile global copper prices and high-risk sovereign jurisdictions (Zambia, Panama). The forced shutdown and care-and-maintenance status of Cobre Panama in late 2023 eliminated over 40% of production, resulting in substantial operating losses, covenant amendments, debt restructuring, and severe dilution. Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC fails the 12% hurdle.
